listSource: PSNProfiles / Exophase trophy list (names, descriptions and grades as PlayStation publishes them)
note: All 55 trophies are offline single-player; there are no online trophies. 28 are hidden on PlayStation until earned. Rarity figures are not published yet, so none are given here. Guides below are written for this entry and cite their sources; the official names and descriptions are quoted as published.

trophies.guide: The platinum is the last trophy you earn: it pops the moment the other 54 are done. There is no separate task behind it, so work the roadmap in order and it arrives on its own.
trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!

sources.name: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide and Roadmap

trophies.guide: Finish the opening mission, Gone Fishing — the first mission of the game, played as Jason. It unlocks through the story and cannot be missed.
trophies.name: Just Like Paradise

sources.name: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide and Roadmap

trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 1. A story trophy: it pops when the chapter ends and cannot be missed.
trophies.name: Paradise Lost

sources.name: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide and Roadmap

trophies.guide: Complete the final mission. The story runs five chapters; this pops at the end of the last one. Free-roam continues afterwards, so finishing costs you nothing.
trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off

sources.name: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide and Roadmap

sources.name: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide and Roadmap

trophies.guide: Complete the mission VCIA Takedown. A story mission: it pops when the mission ends and cannot be missed.
trophies.name: Hi-Jacked

sources.name: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide and Roadmap

trophies.guide: Complete the mission Operation Savage Glory. A story mission: it pops when the mission ends and cannot be missed.
trophies.name: Snow Storm

sources.name: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide and Roadmap

trophies.guide: Reach 100% completion. The checklist appears under Progress, then Stats, then 100% Completion once the story is done, but everything you do before then already counts toward it. It asks for a share of the game rather than all of it: every robbery, underwater discovery, shooting range, drone race and Bret quest, plus 70 of the 80 Challenges. This is the longest trophy in the game and the one the platinum waits on.
trophies.name: A Long Road

sources.name: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide and Roadmap

trophies.guide: Complete 250 stunts. Stunts are jumps, under-bridge flights, Knife Flights and base jumps; the game holds 397 in total, so you need just over three-fifths of them. Progress is tracked in the Progress menu, and most players pick up a large share while travelling between missions — sweep the rest in free-roam after the story.
trophies.name: Cunning Stunts

sources.name: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide and Roadmap

trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each of the nine activity types once: fishing, hunting, golf, the shooting range, pool, basketball, a video game, a race and a stunt. None of them needs to be won or finished — one attempt at each is enough, so this is a quick trophy early on.
trophies.name: Master of None

trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges, spread across the 12 shooting ranges. Each challenge is a short scored trial; gold needs a high score rather than a pass, so use the range's best weapon for the trial and retry the ones you miss — there is no limit on attempts.
trophies.name: The Shootist

sources.name: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide and Roadmap

trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location — 14 in total. Drone races are short courses flown from a first-person drone view; winning each location once is enough, and you can retry any race you lose.
trophies.name: Top Fun

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.guide: Win 20 different races. Any race type counts, and each distinct race only counts once, so work through the race list rather than repeating one favourite.
trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos

sources.name: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide and Roadmap

trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Fishing challenges are head-to-head contests at fishing spots — land the bigger catch before the timer ends.
trophies.name: Baited My Tackle

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.guide: Complete an arcade game. Find an arcade cabinet and play one game through to its end — any game counts.
trophies.name: Stick Fiddler

sources.name: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide and Roadmap

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Andy. Andy's strand is a chain of missions with a finale, and it is Lucia-only — play it while Lucia is the active character. The quest giver returns after the story if you leave it.
trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Kenton. Work through Kenton's missions as they appear; he can be temporarily unavailable mid-story, but he returns, and the strand can be finished in free-roam.
trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Billy. Finish Billy's strand of missions; like the other character strands it can be completed after the story.
trophies.name: The Lone Rider

trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across Leonida. Stranger missions appear as purple icons (and black icons with pink letters) on the map; each strand is a short chain with its own finale, and eight finished strands earn the trophy.
trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks

sources.name: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide and Roadmap

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Randy. Finish Randy's strand; the giver stays available in free-roam if you postpone it.
trophies.name: Supply & Demand

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Tyrone. Tyrone's strand is Jason-only — play it as Jason.
trophies.name: Spin On This!

sources.name: GTA Spotter — GTA VI trophies and achievements

trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at every spot across Leonida — 18 spots in 10 locations, as both Jason and Lucia. MISSABLE WARNING: the first meditation is offered at Jason's house in Chapter 1. After the mission Down to Earth, Lucia mentions meditating in the kitchen one morning and walks out to the balcony — follow her and accept. It may be required for the trophy and it cannot be repeated after Chapter 1, so do it when it appears. The 100% checklist only asks for 15 of the 18 spots, so a missed one does not block A Long Road, but it may block this trophy.
trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude

sources.name: Vice City Hustle — GTA 6 Trophy List

trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret. Bret's quests are Jason-only hunting jobs; the target is one specific marked animal rather than any animal of the species — study animals through the binoculars to find it.
trophies.name: Fair Game

sources.name: GTA Spotter — GTA VI trophies and achievements

trophies.guide: Complete 3 Collectible Card sets. Cards are hidden across Leonida and there are 18 sets in total, so any three finished sets count — follow the sets whose cards you find first and check the in-game collection screen for gaps.
trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck

trophies.guide: WAiNK It at 100 locations. The WAiNK app scans landmarks, curiosities and sculptures — point it at anything notable and the scan counts. A scan also counts toward discovering vehicles, so scan unfamiliar cars as you pass them.
trophies.name: You WAiNKer!

trophies.guide: Complete 50 Challenges. The game holds 80 Challenges in eight groups of ten; any 50 count, so skip the ones you hate — the 100% checklist only needs 70. Track them in the Progress menu.
trophies.name: One Last Thing

sources.name: GTA Spotter — GTA VI trophies and achievements

trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Lose a 4-star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat. Get the police to four stars while your partner is with you, then break line of sight until the wanted level clears. A reliable escape is the train tunnel north of Ambrosia in Kelly County — officers and the helicopter struggle to follow along the tracks.
trophies.name: Hot Together

trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level. Rob one shop, move straight to the next, and keep the wanted level from clearing between robberies — the three shops in the north of Vice City work well because they are close together.
trophies.name: Retail Therapy

trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. New vehicles are discovered by spotting them — a WAiNK scan is enough, so scan every unfamiliar car you pass. The game holds 277 base models and the 100% checklist wants 200 of them, so this pops on the way.
trophies.name: Whip It Good

trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus. Combat Focus is the slow-time aiming mode: before a big fight, raise your focus with food, drinks or a shower at home, carry Adrenaline, and use an assault rifle so five targets drop before the meter runs out.
trophies.name: Gunslinger

trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA. VCIA is the Vice City airport — leave it by an unscheduled route, a runway or service road rather than the terminal exit, and the trophy pops.
trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.guide: Kinda hot in these Rhinos. Rhinos are the army tanks — the trophy's own description is the lead: get into a confrontation with a Rhino tank, or steal one, and survive the heat. No published guide has confirmed the exact trigger yet, so expect a fight with the army rather than a quiet pickup.
trophies.name: Challenging Tank

sources.name: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide and Roadmap

trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. Go in quiet — no alarms, no witnesses calling the police — and get out clean. A stealth approach and a quick exit matter more than speed.
trophies.name: Sneakthief

sources.name: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide and Roadmap

trophies.guide: Rob 5 Bank Vaults and escape. Bank vault robberies are multi-step jobs: crack the vault, grab the cash and lose the wanted level. All five count once you escape each one.
trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal

trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an Armored Truck and escape. Armored trucks travel set routes — stop one, take the cash and get away before the police box you in.
trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play

sources.name: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide and Roadmap

trophies.guide: Explore all of Leonida — all 52 areas. The map fills in as you visit each named area; check the map for greyed-out regions and drive through them. Story missions cover much of the map on their own.
trophies.name: The Goodtime State

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang — 9 gangs in total. Each gang runs illegal operations at marked spots; hit one operation per gang and the trophy pops.
trophies.name: Pest Control

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. The method for this hidden trophy is not confirmed by any published guide yet — the description itself is the lead: find a bar or vendor on Ocean Beach and order a cocktail with the view. This guide will not guess a location the published guides have not confirmed.
trophies.name: In The Beginning…

trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style. The method is not confirmed by published guides yet — the description points at a vehicle showroom: drive a car through the showroom glass in the style of the classic scene it references. Check a published guide before grinding it.
trophies.name: Capital Offense

trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley. The method is not confirmed: PowerPyx reads the description as stealing three valuables from the alley rather than bowling a game, but no guide has confirmed the exact requirement — treat it as unconfirmed and check a published guide before grinding it.
trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling

sources.name: GTA Vice City Hub — GTA 6 Achievements

trophies.guide: A partnership with mass appeal. The method for this hidden trophy is not confirmed by any published guide yet — the description suggests a co-op moment with your partner that draws a crowd. Check a published guide once one confirms it.
trophies.name: Personal Best

trophies.guide: Choices made (for better or worse). Perform 500 actions that affect your Criminal Profile — the running record of crimes and choices the game keeps. Anything that moves the profile counts, so this accumulates through normal play and the crime trophies.
trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder

trophies.guide: Second time's the charm. The method for this hidden trophy is not confirmed by any published guide yet — the description suggests succeeding at something on the second attempt. Check a published guide once one confirms it.
trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess

trophies.guide: What the hell just happened? The method for this hidden trophy is not confirmed by any published guide yet — the description points at witnessing something strange in the world. Check a published guide once one confirms it.
trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There

trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by. The method is not confirmed: PowerPyx reads it as knocking 10 pedestrians off a bike within 60 seconds, but no guide has confirmed the exact requirement. Treat it as unconfirmed and check a published guide before grinding it.
trophies.name: Ten Pin

sources.name: GTA Vice City Hub — GTA 6 Achievements

trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts. Marked Bills come from robberies; launder them through your contacts a little at a time and the total accumulates.
trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar

sources.name: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide and Roadmap

trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops. Any shop spending counts — weapons, clothes, food and cars all add up, so this pops naturally while you play.
trophies.name: Treat Yo Self

sources.name: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide and Roadmap

trophies.guide: Purchase all garage properties — 8 in total. Garages are bought through the in-game property listings; each one adds storage for your vehicles.
trophies.name: Little Boxes

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. Any ten vehicles you own can be registered through the app.
trophies.name: On the Spot

sources.name: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide and Roadmap
